behavior_list.behavior: Telemetry/export failure preserves behavioral state, validity, and acceptance while publication remains pending
Offline evaluation makes no export call and creates privacy-minimized retry evidence
One registry and central CLI list, run, compare, publish, retry, replay, validate, and perform strict release for all 17 skills
Fifteen generic skills use central mechanics while Neo and skill-development retain explicit specialized adapters
Publication is metadata-only, bounded, identity-keyed, retryable without a model call, and reconciles one logical summary/dataset record/assessment set
Strict release fails closed without a complete matrix, passing gate, joined published evidence, and MLflow protection
Protected retention preserves active adopted/restricted evidence, applies a 365-day supersession grace period, and fails safe on malformed references
All packages own definitions and compact deferred manifests while generated result blobs and generic facades are absent
Live MLflow publication, protection, retention dry-run, deletion, backup, deployment, and model-backed matrices

design_decisions: The central CLI is the operator facade; the registry hides package layout and declares adapter ownership.
Definition hashes and a stable evaluation key are computed before execution; a unique execution ID distinguishes attempts.
Behavioral and evidence states are separate; strict mode alone converts pending evidence into command failure.
Retry spools contain only bounded allowed OTLP metadata and are ignored by Git.
Release adoption/restriction updates MLflow protection before writing a Git manifest.
Retention reads MLflow identity/protection tags and selects nothing if any reference is absent, duplicate, or malformed.
broader_checks: All config/agents test files passed individually (75 tests).
home-infra retention tests, Python compilation, and Compose configuration passed.
non_tdd_verifiers: Git diff checks and secret-pattern scan passed.
MLflow 3.13.0 API inspection confirmed MlflowClient.search_traces and delete_traces(trace_ids=...) contracts.
residual_risks: Live authenticated publication, backup, retention dry-run, conformance, and protection queries were not executed without operational authority.
No model-backed smoke or held-out matrix was run; all migrated manifests truthfully remain deferred and non-release-eligible.
The Ship state hashes nix-config only; home-infra base and candidate identities must be checked separately during verification and review.
